intent: Actions for one target, opened with a right-click or Shift+F10.
useWhen: Actions that belong to a row, card, or canvas, not a visible button
The person already knows the target they are acting on
doNotUseWhen: Actions from a visible button — use DropdownMenu
A single obvious action — use Button

items.note: Each item is { id, label, disabled?, danger?, shortcut? }.

children.note: The surface that opens the menu.

requirements: Right-click or Shift+F10 opens the menu at the pointer or the target
Menu is role=menu. Each action is role=menuitem
Arrow keys, Home, and End move. Enter and Space choose. Escape closes
Disabled items are aria-disabled and are skipped
Choosing an item closes the menu

doNot: Do not use ContextMenu when the actions should be visible — use DropdownMenu or Button
Do not put navigation links in the menu
snippet: <ContextMenu items={[{ id: 'rename', label: 'Rename' }, { id: 'delete', label: 'Delete', danger: true }]} onSelect={run}>{children}</ContextMenu>
